versions.short: The joint resolution would disapprove a rule from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services concerning prior authorization for select services under the Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction (WISeR) Model in Medicare, and would declare that rule to have no force or effect. The rule was published on July 1, 2025, and the joint resolution refers to a Government Accountability Office opinion concluding that the notice is a rule under federal law governing congressional review of agency rules.
